rules: World truth and character belief are separate.
A character cannot act on hidden information without a causal information path.
Rumors may be false, distorted, delayed or selectively transmitted.
Jack's source-story memory is JACK_MEMORY, not guaranteed future truth after divergence.
Information transmission requires a sender/source, medium, travel time where relevant, and recipient access.
Contradictory reports remain separate until resolved; do not silently merge uncertainty into certainty.
